news.title: Twenty three years on, Bengaluru’s 1,134 Arkavathy Layout allottees still await sites
news.para: Over a thousand original Arkavathy Layout allottees remain without sites after twenty-three years. The Bangalore Development Authority originally planned twenty thousand sites for this project. Litigation and denotification scandals significantly reduced the available plots for allotment. Many affected individuals have pursued legal recourse and presented evidence. The BDA continues efforts to accommodate remaining allottees as litigation resolves.

news.title: Identify land parcels for student PGs: LG to Delhi development body
news.para: The Delhi government is set to launch a new initiative aimed at ensuring safe and budget-friendly paying guest accommodations for students. Under the directive of the Lieutenant Governor, the DDA is tasked with locating appropriate land for this purpose. Collaborations between universities and external providers are planned for optimized student housing.

news.title: Green NOCs missing, Uttar Pradesh pollution control board shut 15 hotels, restaurants in last two years
news.para: In a decisive action against pollution in the region, the UP Pollution Control Board has mandated the closure of fifteen hotels and restaurants. Additionally, show-cause notices have been issued to fifty-eight more establishments following a thorough review. Out of 625 establishments in Ghaziabad, only 241 have been surveyed so far. For those that didn’t comply, closure orders have been enforced, and electricity connections cut.

news.title: Dehradun PGs ‘flout’ norms, fire safety a concern
news.para: In Dehradun, many private student accommodations are deemed unsafe, with serious concerns over fire safety and building structure. Students frequently experience issues such as moisture, poor airflow, and leaking, while the cramped streets and inadequate infrastructure add to the dangers faced. District officials are now taking action to locate and assess these deteriorating buildings, as numerous facilities reportedly fail to meet safety standards.

news.title: Visakhapatnam initiates state’s first in-situ slum housing project, 177 families to benefit
news.para: The foundation stone ceremony marked the launch of Visakhapatnam's groundbreaking in-situ slum redevelopment project. Aimed at providing modern multi-storey housing for 177 families, it emphasizes safe living conditions without the need for relocation. Residents will benefit from rental assistance during the nine-month construction phase. This innovative approach sets the stage for similar projects across the state upon successful completion.

news.title: Ensure due diligence to curb insolvency framework misuse: IBBI to insolvency professionals
news.para: The Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India (IBBI) has issued a warning to professionals against the potential misuse of the IBC framework. To safeguard against companies evading tax responsibilities, professionals are urged to undertake thorough due diligence. Key warning signs include shared promoters and overlapping creditor committees. Should any fraud be suspected, insolvency experts must promptly file with the Adjudicating Authority.

news.title: Telangana high court orders GHMC to display building permits at construction sites
news.para: The Telangana High Court has made it compulsory for construction sites to exhibit their building permissions visibly. Civic authorities are tasked with the responsibility to oversee ongoing constructions and stop any unauthorized activities right away. The court will seal any structures lacking proper permissions, responding to a businessman’s grievance against GHMC's inaction. The ruling draws attention to the infringement of municipal building regulations and the misuse of self-certification by contractors.

news.title: For elderly owners in Pune, redevelopment stirs up hope & doubts
news.para: Elderly residents face significant challenges and uncertainties during housing redevelopment projects. Many fear not living to see their new homes after lengthy delays and disputes.  Rising rents and legal complications create financial and emotional burdens for seniors.  Disagreements among members and developers often halt progress for years.  A streamlined approval process is needed to ensure timely and fair redevelopment outcomes.

news.title: Axis Bank’s headquarter hunt leaves 3,000 staff scattered across Mumbai
news.para: Axis Bank plans to temporarily relocate staff across multiple Mumbai offices.  The bank seeks a larger single office space for its employees.  This move comes as their current headquarters will be demolished.  A new 32-storey tower is expected to be ready in five years.  This situation highlights Mumbai's growing office space demand challenges.

news.title: SRG housing loans worth ₹400 crore may be fictitious: National Housing Bank
news.para: The National Housing Bank raised concerns over SRG Housing Finance, identifying potentially fictitious loan accounts. Investigations have revealed that around one-third of the lender's loan portfolio consists of these phantom accounts. The inquiry also indicated possible manipulation regarding non-performing assets and the practice of evergreening. Funds linked to these dubious accounts were allegedly redirected to promoters' entities. This issue surfaces amid heightened scrutiny on smaller housing finance firms.

news.title: Karnataka governor puts apartment bill on hold, seeks clarification
news.para: Karnataka's Governor Thaawar Chand Gehlot has decided to halt the progress of the Apartment Ownership and Management Act while he seeks further clarification on specific provisions. Homebuyer groups have pointed out potential conflicts with the central RERA law and raised alarms over the risk of promoters mortgaging common land without appropriate title transfers. This proposed legislation aims to clarify ownership rights and enforce structural assessments.

news.title: Noida: Builder hikes maintenance fee 40%, residents of Cleo County demand rollback
news.para: Residents of Cleo County are voicing their concerns over a staggering 40% rise in maintenance charges, which is retroactive from April. This sudden increase has left many homeowners struggling financially. They are advocating for a rollback and are eager to reach a solution through discussions. The developer has attributed the hike to escalating labor and input costs and has committed to further discussions with residents before the month's end.

news.title: Veegaland Developers attracts ₹63 crore from anchor investors; IPO to open on September 10
news.para: Veegaland Developers has garnered sixty-three crore rupees from anchor investors prior to their two hundred ten crore rupees IPO. The company’s public subscription will officially launch on September tenth and will close on September fifteenth. The funds raised will support current projects and the acquisition of new land.

news.title: Maharashtra to bring land titling act by December: Revenue minister
news.para: By December, Maharashtra plans to implement a Land Titling Act aimed at establishing clear ownership records for properties, thereby minimizing land disputes statewide. The initiative will introduce all-encompassing property cards featuring QR codes for easy data access. Additionally, the government is working to streamline land measurement services, enhancing the efficiency of the revenue department to promote transparent public services.

news.title: Delhi: Safety audit of PGs stokes uncertainty over stay as authorities seal unauthorised buildings
news.para: Civic authorities in Delhi are taking decisive action to seal and demolish illegal paying guest accommodations, leaving many students displaced and on the hunt for secure and budget-friendly housing. This crackdown comes after a tragic building collapse in Satya Niketan, with inspections being carried out to verify compliance with safety standards. Property owners have just three days to submit necessary documentation or face immediate building closures.

news.title: Delhi civic body demolished 34 structures, sealed 17; over 1,200 PG buildings surveyed
news.para: In a proactive response to a tragic building collapse in Satya Niketan, the Municipal Corporation of Delhi has executed 34 demolitions and sealed off 17 properties. They are now meticulously assessing 1,243 paying guest accommodations for their structural integrity. The civic body is also issuing show-cause notices and demolition orders to address various violations, with a survey completion deadline set for September 10th.

news.title: ED questions Punjab IAS officer Anurag Verma in PMLA case linked to realty projects
news.para: The Enforcement Directorate has recorded the statement of former Punjab Chief Secretary Anurag Verma amid an ongoing money laundering investigation linked to land use clearances. This inquiry highlights allegations of irregularities that have purportedly favored real estate developers. Currently serving as Additional Chief Secretary, Verma has submitted relevant documents during his formal testimony, which is rooted in a farmer's report concerning forged consent for approvals.

news.title: Civitech Group to invest ₹500 crore in Greater Noida West commercial project
news.para: Civitech Group will invest ₹500 crore to develop a mixed-use commercial project in Sector 10, Greater Noida West. The project will include hospitality, high-street retail and studio residences on a land parcel acquired through a government auction.
